comment: Which of vercel/next.js's own e2e tests the compatibility harness runs against cdk-nextjs.
Passed to the harness as NEXT_EXTERNAL_TESTS_FILTERS (see .github/workflows/e2e-harness.yml) and
read by next.js's test/get-test-filter.js: `rules.include`/`rules.exclude` are minimatch globs over
test file paths, and `suites[file].failed` lists individual test-case names to skip within a file
`rules.include` is deliberately a short explicit list rather than next.js's own
`test/e2e/**/*.test.{t,j}s{,x}`: the harness creates a separate app per test file, so one file is one
CDK deploy (~3-4 minutes). The full tree is thousands of deploys. Widen this list as the adapter
The `failed` entries below are copied from next.js's own test/deploy-tests-manifest.json at v16.3.5:
cases that do not pass on Vercel's deployment either, so they say nothing about this adapter. Any
case cdk-nextjs fails for its own reasons is a bug to fix, not an entry to add here - if one has to
be excluded anyway, say why in `excluded-notes`.
